name: Qiye Cui
source:
Qiye Cui comes from a fallen noble family from China. She's a kind-hearted, witty and family-driven character with a passion for food. In order to provide food and shelter for her family, she ends up disguising as a man and working at the local market. It is with the intent of not shaming her lineage anymore (and being able to eat 5 bowls of rice a day) that she, then, goes on to marry a monk. 

Voiced by: 无
